non_silent_change_rule: Changes require explicit provenance, review, validation state and normal authority controls.
prospective_boundary: PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATION remains NOT_ESTABLISHED until real prospective forecasts and outcomes satisfy the defined protocol.
bootstrap_requirement: The canonical document must exist, be active, have mandatory_reading=true, and match the registered path and version before scientific missions may bootstrap as valid.
zero_context_requirement: Zero-context reconstruction must load this registry and canonical document metadata before scientific intervention.
